name: topology_complete_node
description: Mark a specific node as completed in the Topology workflow DAG. Records deliverable artifacts, summary notes, consumed costs, and token usage. Automatically transitions the completed node out of "in_progress", advances the next pending node to "in_progress" (if advanceNextNode is true), and automatically marks the entire plan completed if all nodes are done—preventing hanging plans.

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to mark as completed

planId.description: Optional plan ID owning the node. If omitted, the server automatically resolves which plan owns the node.

summary.description: Completion summary or verification notes for this task

outputArtifacts.description: Output artifact files created or modified during this task (e.g. ["src/auth.ts", "tests/auth.test.ts"])

advanceNextNode.description: Whether to automatically advance the immediate next pending node to "in_progress" for seamless single-agent flow

autoCompletePlan.description: Whether to automatically mark the entire plan as completed if all nodes are now complete

costUsd.description: Final actual consumed cost for this completed task in USD

budgetLimitUsd.description: Allocated budget limit for this completed node in USD

budgetUsd.description: Final cost or budget for this completed node in USD (alias)

tokensUsed.description: Token usage consumed during this task (number or object with input, output, total)
